05-01-start: Construct with an xp pane (small, ahead, labelled xp) and a tiling pane (dark grey, to the right); no OPEN CUBE chip in this build.
05-02-xp-view: After a camera glide (a method call, not a walk) the xp desktop fills about a third of the screen; the tiling pane is black at the right edge.
05-03-xp-start-menu: A click on Start inside the pane opens the xp Start menu there (no fly-in needed); only Terminal is in its program list.
05-04-xp-terminal: Terminal opens inside the xp pane and fills the pane.
05-05-xp-typed: echo hello from xp: the shell answers hello from xp in the xp terminal.
05-06-tiling-view: Glide to the tiling pane: it is black (empty, no bar).
05-07-tiling-click: A click into the tiling pane lights its blue edge.
05-08-tiling-terminal: Super+Return inside the pane opens a terminal in tiling that fills the pane. The camera moves by itself, so the pane is at the left of the picture afterwards.
05-09-tiling-typed: echo hello from tiling: the shell answers in the tiling terminal.
05-10-both: Glide back: both panes in view with their terminals (xp small and bright, tiling grey).
